# Trip Planners India

> > Trip Planners India offers customized tour packages across India and international destinations with up to 40% discounts on honeymoon, adventure, heritage, and pilgrimage tours.

Trip Planners India specializes in curated travel experiences from major Indian cities like Delhi, Chennai, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Kolkata to destinations ranging from Himalayan hill stations and Rajasthan heritage cities to international locations like Maldives, Singapore, Bali, and Abu Dhabi. The platform focuses on package deals for families, honeymooners, and adventure seekers with detailed itineraries covering popular attractions like Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Tiger Hill, and Dal Lake.
